name: agents-everywhere-starter-kit
description: Cutaway — repair a connected app, preview the result, and preserve existing work.

scripts.build:cutaway: npm run build --workspace fieldnote && CUTAWAY_NEXT_DIST=.next-production npm run build --workspace web
scripts.lint:cutaway: eslint apps/controller/src examples/fieldnote/src packages/cutaway-core/src packages/cutaway-checks/src apps/web/src/components/cutaway apps/web/src/lib/cutaway-client.ts apps/web/src/lib/server/cutaway apps/web/src/app/api/cutaway scripts/*cutaway*.ts
scripts.verify:cutaway: npm run verify && npm run lint:cutaway && npm run build:cutaway
